box.note: The light box is the page ground by default on every page.

film.note: The whole page turns to film under the system dark scheme; one static grain sheet (body::after) applies. No manual toggle, no per-page surface attribute.

plate.note: Every data plate (vessel viewer, FFR curve, spectrograms, CT phase scrubber, the 404 frame) re-declares the film aliases, so plates are film in both schemes.

bone-2.note: Secondary ink on film, held at 0.80 or lighter (Revision 2 dark floor).

bone-3.note: 0.64 clears 4.5:1 on film-0 and film-1 (5.85:1 and 5.26:1).

colormaps.name: turbo
colormaps.note: Google polynomial approximation; one shared p range for CFD and PINO.

colormaps.name: diverging
colormaps.note: Moreland cool-warm; symmetric about zero; values past +absMax take the over color.

colormaps.name: viridis
colormaps.note: Degree-6 polynomial fit of matplotlib viridis.

name.purpose: The home h1 (the owner's name); Archivo width 92, clamp(2.25rem, 1.5rem + 2.6vw, 3.5rem).

title.purpose: Home section headings (Work, Selected) and CV section headings, over a hairline.

row-title.purpose: Capability names, selected-paper titles, CV entry titles; Archivo 600, 0.975-1.0625rem.

body.purpose: Tagline, capability clauses, research paragraphs and lede; 60ch measure.

caption.purpose: Figure and table captions, at most 18 words; italic STIX in ink-2.

ui.purpose: Nav, buttons, the identity role line, quiet in-page links.

mono.purpose: Link rows (identity, footer), the identity proof lines, the one-line plate caption, citations, DOIs, years, venues, metrics tables, BibTeX, the CV contact row in print; 0.8rem on the box, 13px (0.8125rem) on film.

label.purpose: Corner chrome, colorbar labels, tags, the wipe grip; 0.75rem on the box, 13px (0.8125rem) on film; uppercase only for short unit-free identifiers.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The system is flat. Separation is a 1px hairline in --line or a one-step tonal lift to --bg-1.

shadows.name: segment-pressed-underline
shadows.purpose: A 2px signal underline on a pressed segmented button, drawn as an inset box-shadow. An underline, not an elevation.

texture.name: film-grain
texture.value: feTurbulence fractalNoise baseFrequency 0.9, 2 octaves, desaturated, 256px tile, opacity 0.05, position fixed
texture.purpose: One static grain sheet over the page under prefers-color-scheme: dark only (body::after); none on the light box; never animated; removed in print.

motion.name: duration-quick
motion.purpose: State transitions: hover color, border, underline, skip link.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: The two-state CFD | PINO wipe tween on narrow frames.

motion.name: duration-develop
motion.purpose: The PINO layer develops over the CFD field once, on first visibility, for the measured inference time (1.78 s on one L40S); snaps under reduced motion.

motion.name: drift-period
motion.purpose: Idle drift of the chapter viewer on /research, one revolution; never on the quiet home plate; paused offscreen, on document.hidden and during drags; 0s under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The one easing curve for every transition.

breakpoints.name: nav-compact
breakpoints.purpose: Nav gaps 1rem, type 0.875rem; the four items still fit one row at 390px.

breakpoints.name: metrics-wrap
breakpoints.purpose: Metrics table labels and heads wrap (about 18ch); values keep their readings whole; no horizontal scroll at 390px.

breakpoints.name: identity-compact
breakpoints.purpose: Identity portrait 4rem beside the name; role, tagline and link row full width. Research chapter header to one column.

breakpoints.name: viewer-rows
breakpoints.purpose: Viewer: the wipe handle gives way to a two-state toggle; in chapter plates the colorbar and controls move into rows under the canvas.

breakpoints.name: cv-stack
breakpoints.purpose: CV period rows and skills to one column; talk rows put venue and format under the title; patent status and number go under the title; photos 96px.

breakpoints.name: home-rows
breakpoints.purpose: Home capability and selected rows to one column; the home plate goes portrait (3/4, max 64svh).

breakpoints.name: art-pair
breakpoints.purpose: Research artifact pairs side by side at 7fr/5fr.

breakpoints.name: frame-width
breakpoints.purpose: Max width of the one container.

layout.homeFirstViewport: At 1440x900 the nav, identity block (with its three proof lines), the plate, its one mono caption line and the STIX line end above 900px.
layout.leftEdge: One left edge: every column starts where the nav, plates and footer start.
layout.mailtoBudget: exactly one mailto: per page (the nav Email), none in a redirect stub (scripts/budget.mjs: mailto 1, mailtoRedirect 0)
layout.cvHeader: 80px portrait, the name as h1, the intro line (interestsLine, #interests, STIX 1.125rem, 68ch), two role lines; the mono contact row is display:none on screen and prints.
layout.researchClosing: Plain-text STIX line in ink-2, 72ch, under a hairline 4rem below the last chapter; no link.

formatting.unitJoin: U+202F narrow no-break space between value and unit and as thousands separator (8 649)
formatting.range: en dash, one trailing unit (10.7–13.0 kPa)

precision.quantity: FFR Pd/Pa (metrics table case column; CFD-PINO difference)

formatting.manuscriptStatus: under revision (EAAI): lowercase, venue short form, printed once per entry (CV publications; research citation line with the venue in an abbr).
formatting.doi: doi:<identifier>, lowercase, no space, mono, linked to https://doi.org/
formatting.proseCounts: numberWord: counts in ledes spelled as words
formatting.voice: First person, present tense, plain, for copy that speaks for the owner (tagline, footer line, research paragraphs); third person for author lists and collaborators.
formatting.cfdReference: CFD up to 35 min on 64 CPU cores (owner, 2026-10-16): a measured bound; never converted to hours or extrapolated; no speed-up factor above "≈1,000×".
formatting.framing: Organ-agnostic: computational hemodynamics · physics-informed AI · wearable biosignals · medical devices; coronary only where a coronary result is named.

revisions.summary: Astro rebuild as the cine frame (candidate 6, seed 6687f113); per-page data-surface switch (film on / and /research, light box on report pages); full-viewport home frame with a thesis h1; what/result/consequence caption stack; rank by frame size; Close block.
4D CT phase scrubber; Email, CV and LinkedIn on every page (hero, per chapter, Close block).

System-scheme theme (light box default, film in dark, .plate always film; bone-2 0.80, bone-3 0.64, 13px mono on film); three pages with /publications and /record redirected to CV anchors; identity-first home with the quiet plate; nav Email plus footer as the only contact route (at most 2 mailto); dense CV rows; agent layer (robots with 19 named AI agents and Content-Signal search=yes, ai-input=yes; llms.txt, llms-full.txt, markdown twins, cv.json; JSON-LD @graph); budget gate scripts/budget.mjs run by pnpm build; viewer quiet mode, bounding-box framing (centre 42%, width 8-92%), fixed symmetric error scale, uint16 quantized mesh (115 883 B gzipped).
retired: home Led, About, Applied, Fronts sections
thesis h1 and full-viewport home frame with corner readouts
drift: vessel cap mask still uses round-2 bone-3 (oklch 0.56, sRGB 120 116 109)
manifest timing.cfd.wall_time_s is null; the CFD bound lives in content.ts cfdReference

revisions.summary: Identity: three plain-text mono proof lines (0.45rem apart under 640px), link row LinkedIn · Google Scholar · ORCID. Footer: LinkedIn · Google Scholar · ORCID only; omit (cv: LinkedIn) and links:false (home). One mailto per page, none on redirect stubs; home budget 240 words. Plate: one mono caption line (case id, nodes, FFR CFD and PINO), plateSentence carries the CFD bound and 1.78 s. Home links one target each. Research: plain-text closing row, one Replay for both spectrograms (replayGroup), recordingS accessible names, FFR caption with the s range, Flow caption slide or toggle. CV: intro line under the h1 (#interests), print-only contact row, talk titles without a measure cap. Role marks and REGISTERED tag on ink borders. Agent layer: In brief block in llms.txt and llms-full.txt, ScholarlyArticle authors reference the Person @id, projectRole on funded projects.

CV (PDF) in the identity link row

per-plate Replay buttons on the Pulse chapter

components.name: Identity Block
components.description: The first thing on home: a 96px hairline portrait, the name as the h1 (Archivo width 92), the role line and the four fields in Archivo 500, the owner's tagline in STIX, three plain-text mono proof lines in ink-2 (first-author papers and the paper award; PINO cohort, the CFD bound and the GPU time; patent, project and award counts), each item nowrap with its separator, 0.45rem apart under 640px, and one mono link row (LinkedIn · Google Scholar · ORCID), home's only link row. No Email and no CV; the nav carries both.

Hyeong Jun Lee

components.name: Home Plate
components.description: The one live proof on home: a film plate (height min(44vh, 30rem), min 18rem; portrait 3/4 under 900px) holding the quiet viewer (pressure only, the centred CFD | PINO wipe, the five-tick colorbar), then one mono caption line (case id, nodes, FFR CFD and PINO; no timing line, Revision 2b) and, 0.35rem below, one STIX line (plateSentence) that carries the CFD bound against the PINO 1.78 s and says slide or toggle. No link. Shown on the light box.

CFDPINO

8 649 nodes · FFR CFD 0.83 · PINO 0.82

narrative.northStar: The Light Box and the Film
narrative.overview:
The world is the cath-lab reading room: a light box with angiographic film clipped to it. The page is the light box, white and quiet, carrying who he is and the record in rows. The research is the film: every data artifact (the vessel viewer, the FFR curve, the spectrograms, the CT phase scrubber) is a dark film plate with a hairline and mono corner chrome, sitting on the box. Nothing decorative competes with the plates; UI chrome is thin and mono, so it reads as instrument marking rather than interface.

Three pages. `/` is a Read surface, identity first: name, role, the four fields, the owner's one sentence, three proof lines, a link row, then one quiet live plate inside the same 1440×900 viewport, then rows of work and three selected papers. `/research` is an Experience surface: three worked examples with data (Flow, Image, Pulse), one artifact, one paragraph, one table and one citation line each. `/cv` is the whole record, dense: rows, not frames. `/publications` and `/record` are meta-refresh redirects to `/cv/#publications` and `/cv/#talks`.

The ground follows the system scheme. The light box is the default; `prefers-color-scheme: dark` turns the whole page to film. Plates are film in both schemes, so in dark mode a plate is film on film, separated by its hairline. There is no manual toggle and no per-page surface switch. Components read semantic aliases only (`--bg`, `--ink`, `--line` and their tiers), which the scheme resolves for the page and the `.plate` scope re-declares to film for a plate.

Rank is carried by border ink, never by weight, fill or color flooding. First-author work carries a primary-ink border on its role mark; co-first a secondary-ink border; co-authored a hairline. Signal never marks rank. Type weight stays even (one heading weight, 600), so the eye ranks by geometry.
keyCharacteristics: Light box by default, film under the dark scheme; data plates are film in both. One ink family per ground, one clinical red on both.
Identity first: the name is the h1; the plate is the one live proof in the first viewport, quiet (pressure only, the CFD | PINO wipe, the colorbar).
Rows, not frames, for everything that is a record: capability rows and selected papers on home, dense CV rows on /cv.
Three faces with fixed jobs: Archivo (width 92 for the name and page titles) for naming and UI, STIX Two Text for reading, JetBrains Mono for every number, unit, identifier and link row.
Flat throughout; depth is a hairline or a one-step tonal lift, plus one static grain sheet on a film page.
Signal red is reserved: probes, the PINO trace, active underlines, focus rings, selection, the hover state of icons and underlines, and the one primary action (the nav's Email).
Motion is physical evidence: the PINO layer develops over the measured 1.78 s once, and everything stops under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Two-Ink Rule
rules.body: Each ground has exactly one ink family in three tiers (box-ink on the light box, bone on film), plus the one signal red. No other UI color exists; colormaps belong to the data.

rules.name: The Alias Rule
rules.body: Components read `--bg`, `--bg-1`, `--bg-2`, `--line`, `--line-soft`, `--ink`, `--ink-2`, `--ink-3` only. `:root` resolves them to the light box; `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` resolves them to film; `.plate` re-declares them to film (with `color-scheme: dark` and the film mono and label sizes) for a plate in either scheme. Raw `film-*` and `box-*` values are referenced directly only where an element must hold the other ground inside a plate (the scrubber's light-box sheet).

rules.name: The Plate Rule
rules.body: A plate is any Frame that holds a viewer, a chart, a spectrogram or a CT frame (`<Frame plate>`). It is film in both schemes: dark film on the light box, film on film (separated by its hairline) in dark. Nothing that is not data sits on film.

rules.name: The Light-Box Rule
rules.body: White inside a film plate is the light box of the world, never a bare rectangle: it carries a hairline and mono corner chrome or a caption, and holds only a raster from the paper or the data, composited with `mix-blend-mode: multiply` so the figure's own white becomes the box ground.

rules.name: The Signal-Is-A-Stroke Rule
rules.body: Signal red is a border, underline, ring, curve or icon state. It is a fill only on the nav's Email action and the skip link, and then as `signal-fill`.

rules.name: The Dark Floor Rule
rules.body: On film, secondary ink is no darker than 0.80 lightness and mono and label type never fall below 13px. Every text and ground pair holds at least 4.5:1 in both schemes.

rules.name: The One Grain Rule
rules.body: A film page (the dark scheme) carries exactly one grain layer, applied by `body::after`: a static feTurbulence sheet tiled at 256px at 5% opacity, never animated, removed in print. The light box carries none, and plates add none of their own.

rules.name: The Mono Number Rule
rules.body: Every measured number, unit, identifier, DOI, year and readout is set in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals; `code`, `time` and `data` inherit it globally. A measured value in Archivo or STIX running text is wrapped in `.num`.

rules.name: The One Formatter Rule
rules.body: A precision is a property of the quantity, not of the page: kPa at one decimal, FFR at two (three in the metrics table), seconds at two, mm at one.

rules.name: The Even Weight Rule
rules.body: Headings carry one weight (600), UI 500, body 400. Rank is carried by size, measure and border ink, never by bolding.

rules.name: The Unit Keeps Its Case Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is chrome for short identifiers (C1, J2) and tags; units and ratios are never uppercased or tracked.

rules.name: The One Left Edge Rule
rules.body: Every column starts where the nav, plates and footer start. Measure is the only thing that narrows text; a centered narrower box, a centered plate or an indented caption breaks the rule.

rules.name: The One Target Rule
rules.body: A link target appears once per page in the human layer, and an action word once per viewport. Home links each capability row to its own target and nothing repeats one; the sticky nav carries Email and CV on every page, so no footer, identity block, closing row or proof line repeats them. A page carries exactly one `mailto:` (the nav's), a redirect stub none; `scripts/budget.mjs` fails the build otherwise.

rules.name: The Two Things Rule
rules.body: The human layer is short and uneven: two big things (the identity block and the plate on home; the artifacts on research), everything else as rows and counts. The machine layer (markdown twins, `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, `cv.json`, JSON-LD) is complete.

rules.name: The Hairline-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separation is a 1px line or a tonal step. The only `box-shadow` in the build is the inset 2px signal underline on a pressed segmented button, an underline by another property.

rules.name: The One Anatomy Rule
rules.body: A paper reads the same everywhere (home Selected, the research citation line, the CV): title (linked to the DOI when one exists), venue in mono, role mark, `doi:`. A role mark, tag or label never sits directly above a heading; that is the eyebrow the craft floor bans.

dos: Lead home with who this is: the name as the h1, the role line, the four fields, the tagline, the three proof lines, the link row, then the quiet plate in the same 1440×900 viewport.
Put every data artifact on a film plate (`Frame plate`) with mono corner chrome, in both schemes.
Keep records as rows: capability rows and selected papers on home, dense rows on /cv.

Keep Email to the nav's one primary action and CV to the nav's page link on every page; the footer carries LinkedIn, Google Scholar and ORCID only, minus any link the page's last viewport already shows (`omit`, `links: false`).
Keep the home plate caption to one mono line (case id, node count, FFR CFD and PINO) and let proof line 2 and the sentence under the plate carry the 1.78 s and the CFD bound.
Read only the semantic aliases in components, so they work on the light box, on a film page and on a plate.
Set every number, unit, identifier and readout in JetBrains Mono, computed from content.ts or a manifest and formatted by `lib/format.ts`.
Carry rank by border ink: primary ink for first author, secondary ink for co-first, hairline for co-author; never signal.
Draw field colors from `lib/colormaps.ts` only, with five ticks on every bar and the error field on its fixed symmetric scale.
Describe the work organ-agnostically (computational hemodynamics, physics-informed AI, wearable biosignals, medical devices); coronary appears only where a coronary result is named.
Write the owner's voice in the first person, present tense, plain.
donts: Don't switch a page's ground by attribute or add a theme toggle; the system scheme decides, and plates are always film.

Don't print a contact or CV action twice in one place or one viewport: no Email or CV (PDF) in the identity block or the footer, no per-chapter mail links, no per-entry mail links, no closing contact block, no on-screen contact row on /cv.
Don't link a home target twice, or turn a count or a closing line into a link.
Don't stack labels over a result ("what / result / consequence") or write consequence sentences; a chapter is one artifact, one paragraph, one table, one citation line.
Don't frame a record; frames are for data.
Don't use drop shadows, glows, gradients outside colormaps, blur or translucent panels.
Don't add kickers, eyebrows or section numbers above headings.
Don't introduce a second accent or a fourth ink tier.
Don't uppercase a unit or a ratio or track it.
Don't fill a role mark or tag.
Don't use icon fonts or glyph characters as icons (no "→"); icons are inline Phosphor SVGs sized to the text.
Don't print a manuscript's status twice, as a tag, or in another wording.
Don't set mono or label type below 13px on film, or secondary ink darker than 0.80 on film.
Don't state a speed-up factor larger than "≈1,000×", or convert the CFD bound into hours.
